summary: Implemented the exact ADR 0012 stdio MCP alpha surface with 11 reads, 6 approval-gated mutations, public-engine delegation, structured placeholders, read-only canonical resources, strict isolation and sanitization, lazy optional-SDK loading, CLI/CI wiring, documentation, 108 focused MCP tests, and a green 1,046-test repository gate.
behavior_implemented: Registered exactly the ADR 0012 17-tool surface with hand-maintained Draft 2020-12 schema-version-1 input and output contracts.
Delegated live context, validation, projection, retrieval, task, audit, proposal, dry-run, apply, and rebuild operations to integrated public engine APIs.
Kept inbox_list, artifact_register, and draft_save discoverable as structured NOT-IMPLEMENTED placeholders for unavailable WP-310/WP-420 engines.
Required literal approved: true structurally and at runtime for all six mutation tools.
Enforced per-call bound-context verification, recursive foreign-URI/path denial, secure canonical resource resolution, and symlink/junction refusal.
Mapped failures to sanitized versioned CLI-code/category diagnostic envelopes and recursively redacted normalized secret-key variants and secret-looking text.
Exposed read-only context configuration and canonical validated-frontmatter resources, with no document bodies, prompts, external writes, or non-stdio transport.
Added lazy workctx mcp serve CLI loading, clear optional-dependency exit behavior, CI --extra mcp activation, reference documentation, and official-SDK lifecycle coverage.

assumptions: The operator-pinned base 925aa08c72eb5fa442750ee3d8740636d03b751c supersedes the frozen contract's PENDING-FINAL-PIN placeholder.
WP-310 ingestion and WP-420 draft APIs are absent at the pinned base; task queries are live now while WP-400 enrichment remains future-compatible.
The context configuration resource URI is workctx://<context>/context/configuration; canonical entities retain their standard durable URIs.
The existing pyproject optional extra and uv.lock MCP 2.0.0 resolution are correct, so only CI extra activation was required.
decisions: Use one hand-maintained schema source for discovery and deterministic runtime validation because the low-level SDK does not enforce advertised input schemas.
Compose public projection resolution and CanonicalStore containment with typed frontmatter validation for canonical resources.
Recursively preflight all argument strings for foreign Work Context URIs and path escape patterns before public-engine dispatch.
Preflight-import the optional SDK before its adapter so a true no-extra installation always receives the clear unavailable-dependency error.
Normalize hyphenated, camelCase, compact, and prefixed secret field names and assignment text at the MCP serialization boundary.
deviations: The frozen contract retains base_commit PENDING-FINAL-PIN; it was not modified because the operator supplied the final pin and the contract is outside the worker grant.
The named worktree and branch were absent at session start and were created from the operator-pinned base before implementation.
No objective, architecture, tool-surface, allowed-path, or dependency deviation was made.
security_considerations: All operations remain bound to one local context; the surface has no external writes, network transport, prompts, or raw file-edit tools.
Approval, foreign-context, path traversal, projected-path, symlink/junction, sanitization, and unexpected-exception boundaries are regression tested.
Canonical resources expose sanitized validated frontmatter only and label canonical entity data as untrusted.
SDK absence is handled before optional transitive imports and never breaks unrelated workctx commands.
migration_considerations: This is an additive schema-version-1 adapter and optional CI dependency activation with no canonical workspace schema or data migration.
Projection rebuild remains disposable derived-state mutation and transaction apply retains the integrated atomic audited engine behavior.
unresolved: Wire inbox_list and artifact_register to WP-310 when ingestion integrates.
Wire draft_save to WP-420 and add WP-400 task enrichment without changing the frozen tool names.
recommended_next_action: Implementation lead: validate the report, independently inspect and test base-to-final commit 1bbb7f5cbc0072050f15326f263df0b77c16ffee, integrate it, and later replace WP-310/WP-400/WP-420 placeholders behind the unchanged ADR 0012 surface.
